```{r Step 1: Set Up GSSR Call, include=TRUE}
GSS_START_YEAR <- 2000 
GSS_END_YEAR <- 2024

# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# 3. Requested GSS variables 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Keep these in the same conceptual groups used in the research design. All names are converted to lowercase because gssr's # cumulative data use lowercase variable names.

gss_variables <- c( 
# ---------------------------------------------------------- 
# Employment / job characteristics  
# ---------------------------------------------------------- 
"OCC10", "SATJOB", "JOBFIND", "JOBLOSE", "WEEKSWRK", "YOUSUP", "INDUS10", "WRKSTAT", "HRS1", "RICHWORK", "AIWORRY",


# ---------------------------------------------------------- 
# Job quality / work-family relationship 
# ---------------------------------------------------------- 

"PRESTG10", "NOATHOME", "NONURSE", "MEOVRWRK", "FEOVRWRK",

# ---------------------------------------------------------- 
# Financial / economic evaluations 
# ---------------------------------------------------------- 

"SATFIN", "REALRINC", "REALINC", "FINALTER", "FINRELA", "ECONSTAT",

# ---------------------------------------------------------- 
# General well-being 
# ---------------------------------------------------------- 

"HAPPY", "LIFE", "GOODLIFE", "PARSOL", "KIDSSOL",

# ---------------------------------------------------------- 
# Social class / stratification 
# ---------------------------------------------------------- 

"CLASS", "EDUC", "COHORT",

# ---------------------------------------------------------- 
# Race / demographic characteristics 
# ---------------------------------------------------------- 

"RACECEN1", "RACERANK", "SEX", "CHILDSINHH", "CITIZEN",

# ---------------------------------------------------------- 
# Political attitudes / efficacy / trust 
# ---------------------------------------------------------- 

"CONFED", "SATDEMOC", "TRUST", "TRUSTPPL", "POLINT", "POLVIEWS", "PARTYID", "TAX", "GETAHEAD", "EQWLTH", "HELPPOOR", "HELPUSA", "POLEFF11", "POLEFF18", "LKELYVOT",

# ---------------------------------------------------------- 
# Presidential vote 
# ---------------------------------------------------------- 

"PRES16", "PRES20",


# ---------------------------------------------------------- 
# Work / family / labor attitudes 
# ---------------------------------------------------------- 

"UNION", "NEWS", "BIZMONEY",

# ---------------------------------------------------------- 
# Other potentially important political/economic variables 
# ---------------------------------------------------------- 

"PARSOL", "KIDSSOL"
)

gss_variables <- gss_variables |> stringr::str_to_lower() |> unique()
```


```{r Step 2, Load in GSS Data, include=TRUE}
data(gss_all, package = "gssr") 

gss_years <- gss_all |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    as.numeric(year) >= GSS_START_YEAR, 
    as.numeric(year) <= GSS_END_YEAR)

available_in_file <- intersect( gss_variables, names(gss_years) )

not_found_in_file <- setdiff( gss_variables, names(gss_years) )

not_found_table <- tibble( requested_variable = not_found_in_file )


gss_analysis <- gss_years |> 
  dplyr::select( 
    year, id, dplyr::all_of(available_in_file) )
```

```{r Step 3, Clean and Prepare Data for Analysis, include=TRUE}
availability_list <- purrr::map( 
  available_in_file, 
  function(v) { 
# Construct the variable symbol dynamically. 
variable_symbol <- rlang::sym(v) 

result <- gss_which_years( 
  gss_all, 
  !!variable_symbol 
  ) 

result %>% dplyr::filter( 
  as.numeric(year) >= GSS_START_YEAR, 
  as.numeric(year) <= GSS_END_YEAR ) %>%
  dplyr::rename( available = !!variable_symbol ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate( variable = v ) 
 } 
)

availability_long <- purrr::map_dfr( 
  availability_list, identity ) %>%
  dplyr::select( year, variable, available ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate( year = as.numeric(year), available = as.logical(available) ) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange( variable, year )

if (length(not_found_in_file) > 0) { 
  not_found_long <- tidyr::expand_grid( 
    year = seq( GSS_START_YEAR, 
                GSS_END_YEAR, by = 2 ), 
    variable = not_found_in_file ) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate( 
      available = NA 
    ) 
  
availability_long <- dplyr::bind_rows( 
  availability_long, not_found_long ) 
} 

availability_long <- availability_long %>% 
  dplyr::mutate( 
    status = dplyr::case_when( 
      variable %in% not_found_in_file ~ "NOT IN CUMULATIVE FILE", 
      available == TRUE ~ "AVAILABLE", 
      available == FALSE ~ "NOT ASKED", 
      TRUE ~ "UNKNOWN" ) )


write_csv(availability_long, here("00_rawdata", "GSS_Data", "VariableAvailabilityIndex.csv"))

availability_wide <- availability_long %>% 
  dplyr::select( 
    year, variable, status ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider( 
    names_from = year, values_from = status ) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(variable)

write_csv(availability_wide, here("00_rawdata", "GSS_Data", "VariableAvailabilityIndex_Wide.csv"))

print( availability_wide, n = Inf, width = Inf )


```
